# flowschema

> JSON Schema for agents: tool calls and structured output, checked as models write them. A Rust crate: drafts 4 to 2020-12, two dependencies, no allocation on a check.

flowschema compiles a JSON Schema in about a microsecond, from the request that brings it or
once for many checks, checks a tool call or a structured answer against it with no allocation,
and says what is wrong in words a model can mend its answer from. Beside the check: a schema as a
provider's strict mode takes it (`fit`), what a reply cut off by the output limit wrote whole
(`whole`), whether a call still streaming can still match (`may_match`), and a value read as the
model meant it (`mend`). It is taken from its repository
(https://github.com/localixai/flowschema), MIT-licensed, and made by Localix Lab
(https://localix.ai).
